title: Uranus mod
description: This mod add in your minecraft uranus in end. You want create a Uranus sword? Achivement! You want a Uranus Gem? Achivement! And I made this mod for a fun atmosphere in the End. Enjoy the game! +respect MCreator
body:
The uranium mod adds:

*uranium ore

*uranium

*uranium sword

*uranium pickaxe

*uranium shovel

*uranium hoe

*uranium axe

*uranium potion

*uranium gem

*uranium gem block

*uranium block

*achievements

adds new ore in the End, can only be mined with an iron pickaxe

(in future updates I will add armor, for now it is not available)

you could even call this an End update!

the mod is made for version 1.21.8 neoforge; in future patches I will also add it for forge

chellowiy_paren wishes you a pleasant game!

(this is my first mod so I didn't add too much)
